about_the_game: This pack contains 25 beautiful wallpapers with a selection of images from Arderico's Journey. All wallpapers are in 16:9, 4k resolution.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains mild depictions of violence and artistic nudity, e.g. in images of statues.

detailed_description: This pack contains 25 beautiful wallpapers with a selection of images from Arderico's Journey. All wallpapers are in 16:9, 4k resolution.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 or later, SteamOS
  • Processor: Any x86 processor (Intel or AMD)
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card supporting display resolution up to 3840x2160
  • Storage: 360 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11 (El Capitan) or later
  • Processor: Any 64-bit Intel or Apple Silicon processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any graphics card supporting display resolution up to 3840x2160
  • Storage: 360 MB available space
